_comment: E10.3 priority pick device receipts; valid NO_GAIN or BASELINE_UNSTABLE remains a negative outcome.

jobs.name: e10_pick
cmd: set -eu; out="$1"; mkdir -p "$out"; for f in ember.tgz model.gguf eval100.jsonl COMMITS decode_pick_vm.sh; do cp "/content/chat/upload/$f" "/content/$f"; done; rc=0; bash /content/decode_pick_vm.sh || rc=$?; cp /content/vm.log "$out/vm.log"; if [ -s /content/out.zip ]; then cp /content/out.zip "$out/out.zip"; fi; if [ -s /content/out/gate_summary.json ]; then cp /content/out/gate_summary.json "$out/gate_summary.json"; fi; exit "$rc"
